name: gitea
description: Work with Gitea repositories, issues, pull requests, and releases through your own gitea-mcp server.

GITEA_MCP_HOST.title: gitea-mcp host
GITEA_MCP_HOST.description: Host name (and port, if any) where your team runs gitea-mcp in HTTP mode, such as gitea-mcp.example.com.

GITEA_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Gitea access token
GITEA_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Personal access token from your Gitea user settings (Settings, Applications) with the scopes the agent needs.
